description: This file implements functions related to computing CRC checksums for files and directories, specifically for host tools in the Android Open Source Project. It includes functions to calculate CRCs for individual files, directories, and aggregate CRCs for specific directories like 'bin' and 'lib64'.

methods.name: FileCrc
methods.description: Calculates the CRC checksum of a file specified by its path.

methods.name: DirectoryCrc
methods.description: Calculates CRC checksums for all files within a directory, returning a map of filenames to CRC values.

methods.name: HostToolsCrc
methods.description: Aggregates CRCs for the 'bin' and 'lib64' directories and returns a combined map of file paths to CRCs.
